summary: Tested Premium Radar upgrade (momentum panning, zoom-tier adaptive clustering, Follow Mode/recentre, press-scale on pins) layered on top of already-passing prior session (Radar cleanup + Verified Meetup Spots, iter_89, 8/8). Backend regression (11/11) re-run and passing. Frontend: zoom-in x3 via + button progressed 'Showing your best 4' -> 'Showing your best 16' with visibly more individual avatars and higher-res map tiles; recentre button correctly returned to 'best 4'; event pin tap opened correct event preview; full Meetup Spots flow (3 verified cards, select, continue, safety-confirm, 10 fallback tiles) works exactly as before; Today/Nearby/Encounters/Profile regression and both Explore Demo + Try Business Demo logins pass with zero console errors. Momentum panning and pinch gestures could NOT be tested via Playwright (headless mouse cannot simulate react-native-gesture-handler Pan/Pinch, and pinch needs multi-touch which is impossible with a mouse) -- this matches the ENVIRONMENT LIMITATION already flagged by main agent, code review confirms withDecay/withSpring logic and followMode state wiring (colors.teal/colors.grey) are correctly implemented and match spec; requires real-device/TestFlight verification.
verified_working: Radar zoom-tier clustering: default 'Showing your best 4', 3x tap radar-zoom-in -> 'Showing your best 16' (fewer/no clusters, more individual avatars visible), higher-res tile layer loads (tileBoost>=2)
radar-recentre tap smoothly returns zoom/focus to 'Showing your best 4' and original camera position
radar-event-<id> pin tap still opens correct event preview modal ('Coffee & Co-work Catch-up') -- navigation/behavior unchanged, only press-scale visual added

All prior-session Radar elements intact: Radius/Events/Filters chips, privacy pill + Learn more, bottom stats card, AI Best Nearby Match card, vibe selector + Visible toggle, bottom nav (Today|Radar|Nearby|Encounters|Profile), business pin full label vs personal-event icon-only, no People|Professional switch

Meetup Spots flow fully intact: 3 verified spot cards (Daily Grind 315m/Commons 459m/Riverside 697m) with image/name/category/distance/green badge/chevron, select->Continue->/safety-confirm shows chosen point, 10 fallback tiles + safety message all present
Backend regression: GET /api/business/meetup-spots and GET /api/business/nearby both 200 with correct shapes and auth-gating (11/11 pytest)
Regression: Today/Nearby/Encounters/Profile tabs, Explore Demo login, Try Business Demo login all work, zero console errors observed in any flow
environment_limitations: Momentum panning (withDecay inertia) and pinch-to-zoom cannot be triggered via Playwright headless mouse events -- react-native-gesture-handler Pan/Pinch (especially multi-touch Pinch) is not simulatable this way. Code review of RadarView.tsx confirms withDecay({velocity, clamp, deceleration:0.995}) is wired on pan.onEnd, and Pinch/Pan onStart both call runOnJS(setFollowMode)(false). This needs real-device/TestFlight verification, consistent with main agent's prior finding.

Follow Mode grey state (colors.grey on pan/pinch) could not be visually triggered for the same gesture-simulation reason; code at RadarView.tsx line ~854 (`followMode ? colors.teal : colors.grey`) is correctly wired to onStart handlers and recentre() resetting followMode=true -- confirmed via static code review only, not runtime visual confirmation. Marked as 'needs real device/gesture verification' per review request.
action_items: No functional bugs found this session. Recommend real-device/TestFlight validation specifically for: (1) momentum panning deceleration feel, (2) pinch-zoom gesture, (3) recentre button turning grey mid-pan/pinch and back to teal on recentre tap -- none of these are testable in this headless Playwright environment.
critical_code_review_comments: RadarView.tsx is now ~1240 lines -- approaching the 700-line guideline threshold significantly; consider splitting MapAnchor/ZoomRing/RingLabelA and the marker-placement useMemo logic into separate files for maintainability.
ZOOM_TIERS/tierFor/zoomBy/recentre logic is clean and correctly bounds MAX_SCALE/MAX_MARKERS/EVENT_MARKER_CAP; tier thresholds (1.4/2.2) align with the 4/9/16 marker budget as designed.
Follow Mode implementation (setFollowMode via runOnJS from worklets) correctly avoids calling React state setters directly from the UI thread -- good pattern.

locationService.ts adaptive GPS cadence and AppContext.tsx heartbeat changes were not device-testable in this environment (no real GPS); code was not deeply reviewed for this session beyond confirming no import/syntax errors given app loads and runs without crashing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows passed; gesture-only features (pan momentum, pinch, live grey recentre state) are an environment limitation, not a failure
